prompt: Jade races Orange around the block
title: Block Race Tonight
irony: Orange the must-win coach only truly wins when he slows down and finishes side by side with Jade.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Lamplight glows round the quiet block as Jade hops by the start chalk line with Orange.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Jade dares Orange to race right round the block, and Orange shouts One more lap, already sprinting.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black cries Bet you can't race with no stops, and Jade hands Green her juice cup at the lamp.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The whole gang chants the block race chant as Yellow calls And they're off from her porch.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Jade sprints too fast past three lamps, then pants and clutches her side as Orange zooms ahead.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Orange trips on his own loose lace by the bench as Yellow shouts, and Jade giggles and stops to help.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The gang chants the block race chant again as both racers catch breath under the lamp.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Orange stands alone under the lamp and sees his win-hunger spoils Jade's fun run.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Orange ties his lace slow, offers Jade his hand, and chooses to finish the block together.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: They trot the last stretch side by side as Orange sings the win is coming home together.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: They chant the block race chant, lamplight still glows, walking home hand in hand, no loser.
